generated_for: Meridian product team — competitive & industry radar
note: Fictional source items (competitor changelogs + industry news) used to demonstrate a stateful monitoring workflow. Add a new item and re-run to see dedup surface only what's new.

items.title: Loopwork ships AI standup summaries
items.content: Loopwork now auto-generates daily standup summaries from task activity, delivered per-team to Slack. Positioned as a way to cut status meetings.

items.title: Cardinal adds warehouse-native dashboards
items.content: Cardinal Analytics launched dashboards that query Snowflake and BigQuery directly, removing the sync step and cutting dashboard latency to near real-time.

items.title: Tasklet introduces usage-based pricing
items.content: Tasklet moved from per-seat to usage-based pricing (billed on active automations), undercutting seat-heavy competitors for small teams.

items.title: Buyers increasingly expect native AI, not add-ons
items.content: A survey of B2B software buyers finds AI features are now table stakes; teams penalize products that gate AI behind a premium tier.

items.title: Loopwork opens a public API for automations
items.content: Loopwork released a public REST API with webhooks and an automations SDK, targeting teams that want to build custom workflows.

items.title: Cardinal SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA now available
items.content: Cardinal Analytics announced SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance, opening the door to healthcare and regulated-industry buyers.
